Subject: Renewal & invoice reconciliation for marketplace private offer — Horizon Health

Marcus,

Thanks for the quick check-in last week. Procurement is working through the marketplace private offer renewal and we need to reconcile a few items before the PO is issued:

- Confirmation on the acceptance evidence window (we have a 10-business-day acceptance window noted; need to confirm what counts as "evidence" for staged activation).
- How the escrow invoice will be applied vs. the initial tranche on the PO (we saw a one-time escrow line on the quote and need the accounting treatment for our AP team).
- Final credit/overage calculation if we move some usage from hosted to dedicated during the first quarter after renewal.

Attached my procurement checklist — can you put the Redwood contacts on the ones that require action and provide any legal/ops notes we should forward to finance? We need this wrapped so we can cut the PO by 7/25.

Thanks,
Liam

Subject: RE: Renewal & invoice reconciliation for marketplace private offer — Horizon Health

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the checklist. I ran this by finance and ops and proposed the following plan so your AP and procurement teams have what they need for PO issuance by 7/25:

1) Acceptance evidence: we will accept the existing runbook + onboarding checklist + one-week usage spike report as valid evidence for staged activation. I attached the evidence pack template we use for marketplace acceptance.

2) Escrow invoice treatment: the escrow line is an initial deposit applied to the first tranche; it will be recorded as a prepayment/credit on Redwood's side and your AP should invoice against the first invoice where the credit line will be netted. We'll provide an invoice reconciliation statement at invoice issuance for the first two tranches.

3) Capacity/overage credits: if you convert hosted consumption to Dedicated in Q1, we will pro-rate the committed units and apply a one-time usage adjustment credit. The adjustment calculation: (committed unit delta) x (monthly unit price) x (remaining months in term / term length). Finance will provide an exact example with today's numbers — see invoice_split_matrix.xlsx.

Next steps (suggested):
- Kimberly: legal to confirm the phraseology on the escrow credit and acceptance evidence (cc'd).
- Soojin: ops to confirm the staged activation dates and acceptance window (cc'd).
- Liam: if acceptable, procurement to confirm PO format and who signs.

I'll drop short attachments (evidence pack + invoice matrix) and a DocuSign draft to legal after Kimberly flags.

Thanks —
Marcus

--

marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0198

Thanks Marcus — quick legal notes for procurement and AP: 

- Escrow/credit language: we'll add the following sentence to the private offer schedule — "An initial escrow deposit reflected on the purchase order will be applied as an invoice credit against the first invoice(s) and reconciled within 60 days of first invoice issuance." That gives AP the audit trail they typically want.
- Evidence window: "Acceptance evidence" will include the specific runbook items enumerated in the attached evidence pack; please ensure Horizon flags any exceptions during the 10-business-day window.
- DocuSign: I'll generate a revision of the private offer with the escrow clause and the acceptance criteria inserted. I'll send a DocuSign link once revised.

Liam — expect the DocuSign link from me later today. If procurement needs a pre-signed PDF for internal routing, let me know and I can send the unsigned PDF too.

Ops notes for acceptance and tranche reconciliation (short):

- Acceptance artifacts: the evidence pack PDF + a one-week usage spike CSV from your monitoring (we can accept an exported report from your cloud billing dashboard).
- Staged activation timeline: once DocuSign is executed we'll schedule the first tranche activation within 5 business days; escrow credit will appear on the first invoice and I'll generate the reconciliation statement for AP within 3 business days of invoice issuance.
